purpose: Teach: 辞める/肩書き/党内/プロダクト/親会社/やりがい/チャネル/紛失

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、辞める、絶対、社員、絶対、面談しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Listen. I need you to conduct proper exit interviews with anyone leaving the company. I'm serious about this.
lines.style: Direct and authoritative opening. Sharp consonants. No room for misinterpretation. Steady eye contact, slight forward lean. The tone of someone used to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、肩書き、絶対、整理、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're already organizing our role titles and moving forward with the restructuring. I appreciate your confidence.
lines.style: Respectful but assured. Measured pace, each clause deliberately placed. Slight nod of acknowledgment. Shows he's already on it without defensiveness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界、本気で、絶対、党内、絶対、の、絶対、動向、絶対、注視しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Watch the market movements carefully. I want you tracking industry shifts and competitive trends closely.
lines.style: Lean forward slightly. Crisp, unadorned language. Emphasis on 'watch'—make it a firm instruction, not a suggestion. Maintain steady attention.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新、本気で、絶対、プロダクト、絶対、発表、絶対、準備中です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're preparing the announcement for our new product launch. Thank you for the direction.
lines.style: Poised and professional. Slight upward inflection on the update—showing progress. Warm but formal. The tone of someone reporting good news to someone who matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、親会社、絶対、報告、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Make sure those reports to the parent company are submitted on schedule. Don't let this slip.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Emphasis on accountability without drama. Slight tightening on 'don't let this slip'—a quiet warning. Still controlled, exacting.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、本気で、絶対、やりがい、絶対、感じられる、絶対、職場、絶対、目指しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're building a workplace where our staff can really feel fulfilled and find purpose in their work. Thank you for the opportunity.
lines.style: Sincere and grounded. Slightly slower pace—this matters to him. Soft conviction under the surface. The pride of someone who believes in what he's doing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 販売、本気で、絶対、チャネル、絶対、拡大しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Expand our sales channels. We need broader market reach. Get it done.
lines.style: Sharp and direct. Three clean statements—no elaboration needed. Command tone. The finality of someone who has made a decision.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。書類、本気で、絶対、紛失、絶対、防止、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We've strengthened our document control procedures to prevent any losses. I appreciate your trust.
lines.style: Calm and assured. Measured delivery showing competence and attention to detail. Slight nod of reassurance. The tone of someone who takes operational rigor seriously.
